headline: Mountain Jawling
title: Mountain Jawling | Hidden in a Ruin | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Mountain Jawling is a Wind form of Jawling, and you find it in Russet Highlands, not by roaming but by solving a puzzle in a hidden ruin. Catch it, then raise it to level thirty eight and it evolves into Helmwhelp. Helmwhelp can then reach Helgon at level forty eight. Have you solved the Jawling ruin yet? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Mountain Jawling is a Wind form from Russet Highlands, found by solving a puzzle in a hidden ruin. At level 38 it evolves into Helmwhelp, and later Helgon at level 48.
